title: ReviewPlan
description: every task of one review, each task is one check on a group of files

schema.description: Format version of this file. Always `gargoyle/plan@1`.

skipped.description: Files left out of the review and why. Nothing is dropped silently.

CheckId.description: Stable check id: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Must match the file name.

Confidence.description: How sure you are this is a real problem, from 0.0 to 1.0.

commit.description: The merge base commit. The review covers every change after it.

RepoPath.description: File path relative to the repository root, with forward slashes, e.g. "src/app.ts".

RunId.description: Id of one review run, 12 hex characters taken from a hash of its prompts.

Skipped.description: A file left out of the review.

check_id.description: Set when only this check skipped the file, like a change too large for its budget.

Task.description: One check on a group of files.

answer_path.description: Where the reviewer writes its JSON answer, relative to the repo root.

checks.description: The checks this task reviews the files against.

estimated_tokens.description: Rough size of the prompt, at 4 characters per token.

id.description: Unique in the run, like `review-1`, or `security-review-1` with one task per check.

paths.description: Files this task reviews. Findings must point at one of them.

prompt_path.description: The reviewer's prompt, relative to the repo root.

TaskCheck.description: A check a task reviews against.

min_confidence.description: Findings below this confidence are left out of the report.

TaskId.description: Id of a task inside a run, like `security-review-1`.
